missingHeroErrors.context: Mostly long no-hero/menu intervals; not proof of sustained combat slowdown.

nativeAssetUnload.scope: Scene/menu loading only; not attributed uniquely to this mod.

findings.classification: confirmed static risk; strong candidate for reported incident
findings.mechanism: Destination readiness excludes neither cinematics nor relinquished control. An accepted warp waits for the original scene and snapshot indefinitely. Thirty seconds only displays a warning. An automatic scene advance can retain changingScene, causing the sender to advertise Loading and preventing reverse warps.
findings.missingEvidence: Logs do not record warp request/accept serial, target scene or changingScene transitions.

findings.classification: observed warning; confirmed logging overhead; layout cause unresolved
findings.mechanism: 753 rejected FSM states in GG_Radiance. Each warning uses stack-frame origin lookup and log output. Exact entity/FSM is absent from the message.

findings.classification: confirmed static overhead; frame impact unmeasured
findings.mechanism: The changing child ClipTimeSeconds is included before ContentEquals, keeping full CombatState snapshots dirty at up to 20 Hz. Snapshot compression/decompression and all-node application remain on the main thread.

findings.classification: confirmed static allocation path; frame impact unmeasured
findings.mechanism: Both sides rebuild component arrays and MaterialPropertyBlocks every two seconds. Client Parts are constructed then discarded when preserving old animation/motion history. Lookup preservation also linearly searches old nodes for each new node.

findings.classification: observed no-hero logging; static candidate callers; frame impact unmeasured
findings.mechanism: HeroController.instance logs and searches when no hero exists. Playable and other polling use it; per-frame shade sets, GUIStyle and overlay sorting add allocations. Caller-specific attribution is unavailable.

limits: No frame-time trace, FPS benchmark, GC allocation measurement or vanilla A/B comparison.
No runtime reproduction of the stag incident.
No tests, gameplay source edits, build, installation, save changes, game restart or debugger attachment.
Existing runtime findings and P5 exit remain open.
minimalFollowup: Reject non-gameplay destinations and target cutscenes before accepting a warp; keep map presence separate from teleport eligibility.
Clear only this warp operation after scene abandonment or failure, preserving native scene transition control; add concise request/accept/end reasons.
Locate the exact Radiance entity/FSM causing state mismatch, then repair its mapping rather than suppress warnings.
Avoid rebuilding unchanged Parts and sending a complete state solely for advancing presentation time; preserve complete initial/takeover snapshots.
If requested, measure frame-time and GC in isolated identical scenes with and without the mod; avoid broad regression reruns.
